code='def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if all(x == row[0] for x in row):
            out[r] = [2 if x == row[0] else x for x in row]
    for c in range(w):
        vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]
        if all(x == vals[0] for x in vals):
            for r in range(h): out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'
